c02_sequence_mask_support.limit: Synthetic deterministic masks only. No interpolation; covariance-agnostic bounds are not confidence intervals or process calibration.
c02_sequence_mask_support.result: PASS: cumulative results now use only exact measured sites present at every step and enforce the declared minimum count/coverage. Adjacent valid comparisons are preserved with INCONCLUSIVE sequence status when common support is insufficient. Sequence uncertainty uses first/last endpoint marginals; intermediate measurements cancel from endpoint totals instead of being double-counted.

c02_uncertainty_bounds.limit: Bounds are mathematical SD limits, not confidence intervals or calibrated process uncertainty; do not infer covariance from marginal uncertainty.
c02_uncertainty_bounds.result: Added sharp marginal-only standard-deviation bounds under unrestricted valid cross-step and cross-site covariance while retaining the explicitly conditional independence estimate. Across 10,000 Monte Carlo replicates for each of rho=0, 0.5, 1, the known analytical standard deviation fell inside [0, 2.00998] nm; the conditional ±1σ coverage was 12.01%, 17.75%, and 100% respectively.

c03_context_drift.limit: 500/500 hidden site-confounded estimates remained VALID with the residual-confounding caveat; stale/unreported population epochs are not detectable from absent source semantics. No causal claim or engine change.
c03_context_drift.result: 500/500 stable-null runs; nominal 95% coverage 477/500 (95.4%, Wilson interval recorded); seven declared context drifts and four support/selection failures each abstained 100/100.

c03_nested_lot_cluster_inference.method: Average Fisher-z wafer correlations within each lot, then calculate the nominal t interval across independent lots. Leave-one-lot-out removes an entire lot. Equal lot weighting avoids wafer pseudoreplication; lot independence and synthetic measurement assumptions remain unverified for manufacturing.
c03_nested_lot_cluster_inference.result: 500 independently generated investigations; actual associate_quality accepted both one-wafer and two-wafer-per-lot designs with zero invalid results. Coverage of the known 0.32 correlation was 95.6% for one wafer/lot and 96.2% for two; Wilson intervals 93.4%-97.1% and 94.1%-97.6%. Two-wafer lot-clustered median interval width fell 11.37% at the same 20 independent lots.

c03_targeted_review_2026_11_24.epoch_and_selection: Declared drift and invalid support abstained in existing replicated tests; hidden residual confounding and unadjusted multi-hypothesis intervals remain explicit limits.
c03_targeted_review_2026_11_24.informative_cluster_sizes: The 500-replicate nested-lot study covered one and two wafers per lot; estimates were accepted with 95.6% and 96.2% coverage for the known synthetic correlation.
c03_targeted_review_2026_11_24.missingness: Removing an observed site triggered exact-mask INCONCLUSIVE rather than fabricated correspondence.
c03_targeted_review_2026_11_24.result: No method defect demonstrated; preserve equal-lot inference and abstention.
c03_targeted_review_2026_11_24.unequal_lot_sizes: 10 positive lots x 3 wafers and 10 negative lots x 1 wafer yielded equal-lot r approximately 0 versus naive wafer-weighted r=0.6.

c03_temporal_epoch_reporting.guardrails: Epoch cutpoint, labels and minimum support require reviewed/predeclared source metadata, source ID and approval reference; at least 10 independent lots per stratum; lot cannot span strata. Stratum intervals are nominal and unadjusted. Hidden source-omitted temporal epochs remain undetectable.
c03_temporal_epoch_reporting.result: 500/500 temporal-reversal cases expose opposite nominal per-epoch intervals although the pooled mean is 0.000557; 500/500 declared context-drift cases and 400/400 invalid-support cases abstained. Stable-null nominal 95% coverage was 477/500 (95.4%; Wilson 93.2%-96.9%).
